page_title: PIS 0-0 LAZ | Pisa v Lazio 30/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' A cross from a corner kick by Pisa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+3' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Pedro (Lazio) causes Adrian Semper little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
89' 10:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.
86' Matias Vecino (Lazio) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Pisa will have a goal kick.
85' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
82' Pedro (Lazio) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
82' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
81' It is time for a substitution. Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) is on for Gustav Isaksen.
80' Wow, what an escape. Stefano Moreo (Pisa) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
77' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
77' Samuele Angori (Pisa) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
74' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Davide Massa and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
73' Pisa force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
70' Samuele Angori (Pisa) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
68' The ball possession is 40:60.
65' Substitution. Ebenezer Akinsanmiro (Pisa) has come on for Marius Marin.
65' Here is a change. Juan Cuadrado is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Stefano Moreo (Pisa).
65' Substitution. Matteo Tramoni leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris (Pisa).

62' A sweet pass inside the box gives Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
61' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' Mario Gila (Lazio) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Oliver Provstgaard replaces him.

60' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
60' The free kick from long range, taken by Pisa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' Luca Pellegrini is substituted due to injury. Maurizio Sarri gives a chance to Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
58' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Matias Vecino (Lazio) replaces Toma Basic.

56' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
55' Adrian Semper comes off his line to intercept the corner from Toma Basic (Lazio).

55' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play and Lazio have been awarded a corner kick.

53' A cross from the by-line finds Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
52' Pisa quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

51' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders. Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 45:55.
47' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. It's a throw-in for Lazio.
46' The game is over for Daniel Denoon. Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) comes on for the second half.
46' Maurizio Sarri makes a half-time substitution. Pedro comes on in place of Boulaye Dia (Lazio).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Lazio enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
44' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
42' The free kick from long range, taken by Lazio, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
41' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Daniel Denoon (Pisa) for his blatant foul.
40' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.

39' Toma Basic (Lazio) picks up a wayward pass but gives away possession by shooting from distance. The ball went miles wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Pisa.
38' Lazio string together a series of short passes.
36' What a shot! Toma Basic (Lazio) decides to unleash a long-range missile of a shot, but his effort smashes against the right post.
34' M'Bala Nzola (Pisa) commits a foul and Davide Massa immediately signals a free kick.

32' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Adrian Semper leaps like a salmon to deny him.
31' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
30' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
30' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
27' A pass from Idrissa Toure (Pisa) is intercepted by Ivan Provedel and the move breaks down.
26' Lazio hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.

25' Juan Cuadrado plays a beautiful lofted pass to Idrissa Toure (Pisa), who somehow crashes the ball well wide of the left post from a promising position. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
22' Toma Basic (Lazio) produces a good strike that sails to the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
20' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Idrissa Toure (Pisa) offside.
19' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) is penalised for a foul. Davide Massa had a clear view and blows his whistle.

17' Pisa slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
14' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
12' Some neat passing and movement from Lazio as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
9' Juan Cuadrado (Pisa) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.

7' Matteo Tramoni (Pisa) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
7' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
5' Idrissa Toure (Pisa) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. Pisa will take a throw-in.
3' Lazio seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Lazio will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Davide Massa.
